description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The first component contains physically measured blade-root flapwise bending moments from three Riso-DTU turbines. Fields include ten-minute mean wind speed, its standard deviation and maximum bending moment in MN-m. A second component supplies 1,000 synthetic training observations and ten million test observations in 100 subsets for extreme-load extrapolation. CSV and text formats are described inside the archive. The J48 publication data archive may overlap this family; metadata does not prove exact shared rows or byte identity. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
